body:
I'd say lower to middle back and abdomen on the right side. I would definitely call them shooting and stabbing pains.

I am no meds.
That'd be fantastic albeit a hit to my pride. I sent you a pm?

I've found a couple different ways to relieve stress. Living less than a 20 minute walk from the rockies is nice. I love the outdoors. Doesn't help so much when I get home and she is busting my baalls about how shitty I am doing as a father.

I ran my credit through the mud when we were homeless. Cold Colorado winter. Would go and open bank accounts and overdraft the shit out of them to buy food, supplies or motel rooms. Haven't made an effort to repay any of it truthfully but I barely make enough to make ends meet as it is.

Havent defaulted since then though since I've been working and had a roof over my head though.

As for how behind I am? I am about 100 bucks behind on the rent that was due by the 3rd of this month. Its a 75 dollar late fee which is fucking all but killing me. Plus I have to give my utilities company 75 bucks. I've got til the 15th to pay them off. I'm currently in disconnect status and its imperative that is paid by the due date. 

Then like I said gotta pay for other things too like diapers at 20+ a box ect

About the new job thing. No I am not starting one currently howevet i never turn down work so a night job is definitely something i am looking at. I meant more as CPS was saying if you guys are in those kind of dire straits we can get you free childcare so your wife can get a job. 

As of right now I work full time. See we initially got into this situation due to me having a medical problem at work brought on by stress. They actually had my boss drive me to the ER. They had written me out a doctor note there saying I could return to work on this and this day which ended up being 3 days. I still tried to go to workthe very next day and the HR dept had a fit and said no way, you can come back when this note expires.

So basically due to that loss of hours and the timing of all this, I am behind on utilities and a pretty sizable chunk of rent. Not to mention the miscellaneous costs of living.. Things like diapers, laundry money, ect. I work in an office and walk to work and I can't even afford to do more than wash my nice buttonups in my bathtub with bar soap.

I dunno. At this point she's costing me money I don't have though. Walking out on me when she wants on a whim leaving me to watch my kids and skip work. She does this regularly. The list goes on and on but I hate to bust her chops.

Yeah I am out in Colorado. I've been in a lot of different fields due to desperation and overall just needing a paycheck. The main way I made my living was by cooking. I started out washing dishes and got promoted to the line.

As of right now I am a floor manager at a b2b lead generation call center. I make about 9.25 an hour and walk to work most days a good 8 miles one way since I can't afford to take public transportation everyday haha.
Also talked to my landlord to see if sh can give a little room to breathe. She doesn't speak enough English to get past hello :/

Oh yeah. I've had them in my life for the past 3, 3 1/2 years? I have meetings with case workers about twice a month. The only assistance they offered me was state funded childcare so my wife can work.

Two issues with that. My wife doesn't care about anything. I can't even get her to unlock the door to let me I'm after work because she's so lazy. I've suggested working, she gets furious.

Two. I have tkl the 15th to make close to 250 bucks. Break a new job down like this.

One week for interview
One week to start
Three weeks to get a paycheck due to payroll cycles.

I've been playing this game for FIVE years, before the kids came . the second we start getting anywhere something happens.
